commits.subject: Add a Durable Object rate limiter and cache helper

notes: One module (src/api/rateLimit.ts): fetch-handler RateLimiter Durable Object with an in-memory bucket per caller (key = raw Authorization header, else IP), middleware returning 429 {error:'rate_limited', retryAfter:1}, skipped when the binding is absent, and cache(60) = Cache-Control: max-age=60 on /levels. wrangler.jsonc: binding plus v1 migration; --dry-run bundles it. 16/16, pnpm build passes. No Retry-After header; raw token used as the object name.
